chars.K: KARIM: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers, a small backpack.
chars.U: UNCLE: a stylish older man with a short grey beard drawn on his white face, wearing a burgundy leather jacket over a black turtleneck, dark sunglasses pushed up on his head, a thin gold chain, black trousers and polished brown boots.
chars.W: WAITRESS: a young woman wearing a white shirt with a long black apron, holding a small tray.
chars.C: GIRL: a young woman wearing a long forest-green wool coat, a cream knitted scarf and a brown leather shoulder bag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cozy Dublin pub-cafe with wooden tables. UNCLE leans confidently on the counter, winking and charming the WAITRESS, who laughs shyly. KARIM sits at a table next to them, covering half his face with his hand, deeply embarrassed. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On a Dublin street with colorful Georgian doors. UNCLE walks proudly like a movie star, adjusting his leather jacket collar with one hand, chest out. KARIM walks beside him, looking at him amazed and amused.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a bright modern supermarket aisle with shelves of products. UNCLE pushes a shopping cart, KARIM walks next to him holding a basket, both casual.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the supermarket aisle. UNCLE leans close to KARIM with a sly mischievous smile, raising one finger as if he has a brilliant plan. KARIM looks at him suspicious and curious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the supermarket near the fruit section. UNCLE confidently steps in front of the GIRL, who is choosing apples and looks up surprised. KARIM stands a few steps behind, frozen with wide eyes.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the supermarket. UNCLE talks politely to the GIRL with an open charming hand gesture, as if asking her something. The GIRL holds an apple and looks confused, eyebrows raised.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the supermarket. UNCLE points proudly with his thumb at KARIM, presenting him to the GIRL. KARIM turns red and wants to hide behind the shelf, mortified. The GIRL looks at KARIM curiously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the supermarket. UNCLE holds out a few blank green banknotes toward the GIRL with a big generous grin. The GIRL stares at the money speechless. KARIM in the background face-palms in total embarrassment.
